title: 第一百七十四章 黑海来信第一百七十三章 西游风波
lines: 船楼外间，陆宁听着伊莎贝尔怯怯的讲述，这伊莎贝尔，还真是索菲亚的表妹，现今她被庞贵妃带着沐浴过，褴褛的衣衫换成了几名英格兰女奴那种雪白水手学生制服裙，越发的明艳动人，和索菲亚还真成了一对儿极为漂亮的巴黎贵族姊妹花，不过索菲亚更美艳一些，伊莎贝尔则更清纯甜美。
索菲亚一脸高傲的坐在一旁，哪怕半个时辰前，刚刚从舷窗看到了齐人的楼船用恐怖的火球和火箭雨，将诺曼底公爵的旗舰变成了一片火海，诺曼底公爵在近卫护卫下仓皇登上小舟逃生的情形。
只是听到伊莎贝尔说起往事，遇到和她记忆不符的，她会恶狠狠瞪向伊莎贝尔。
伊莎贝尔很怕她，根本不敢向她的方向看。
听伊莎贝尔讲述，索菲亚这个表亲家对她还是很好的，不过因为诺曼底公爵归根结底还是被法兰西贵族认为是维京海盗，是以，对要嫁给维京海盗的索菲亚，不免就有很多闲言碎语，加之索菲亚原本因为是路易五世国王唯一的子女，路易五世极为疼爱她，她在宫廷在巴黎贵族圈都是高高在上，小小孩童突然遭逢父王驾崩的惨剧，又被人篡位，有一段时间，她的侍女们都纷纷逃离，以为她会公主的地位都不保而受到牵连。
这种巨变四五岁的孩童哪里能承受，本就心理可能出现了问题极为敏感，是以，在其表亲家的经历，对她来说，可能就是极为糟糕的体验了，以至于，不知道怎么，在她出嫁不久的现今，其表亲家突然就成了她最痛恨的人。
而现今，诺曼底公爵理查二世和法王罗贝尔二世关系极为密切。
法兰西王国，是封建制度比较彻底的王国，尤其卡佩家族刚刚掌权十几年，各公国的公爵，根本不听巴黎来的号令，甚至南面的勃艮第公爵，简直不把法王当人，经常北上侵掠。
法王罗贝尔二世，只有依靠诺曼人，才能遏制这些蠢蠢欲动的强大诸侯。
伊莎贝尔家族的衰落，便传闻是来自诺曼底公爵的不满。
前不久，伊莎贝尔收到索菲亚写来的信，说是要将她嫁给英格兰一位酋长。
如果说，诺曼公爵现今还被不少法兰西贵族看作蛮子的话，英格兰酋长就是他们眼里的原始人了。
伊莎贝尔当然不愿意，结果便是几天前，她前去修道院见朋友的路上，被人绑架，从那些绑匪嘴里，她知道了是这位表姐是幕后主使。
听着伊莎贝尔讲述，陆宁好笑的看向索菲亚，“你这心肠，未免有些歹毒。”
索菲亚俏脸冰冷，并不理会陆宁。
外间英格兰女奴的声音：“阿爷，曹先生求见阿爷。”
她们对主人的称谓，自然是庞贵妃教的。
不仅仅仓促集结起来的水师被河东号及护卫舰打得七零八落，齐人更趁机烧毁了其停泊在码头的许多舰船，虽然河东号代表不了大齐最新的水军技术，但近海交战可能比东海级远洋舰威力更大，比如专门为近战准备的猛火油和火药结合的掷火弹，比之希腊火的破坏力怕是更大，用来烧毁地方停泊在码头的船只，就更是最佳的武器。
诺曼底公爵理查二世显然悲哀的发现，莫名其妙，他自己拥有的海船已经损失了十之八九，而现今齐人大可以大摇大摆离去，而他，不但只能眼睁睁看着，甚至，以后更没有机会，能找到这些绑架了他夫人的齐人。
是以，理查二世派使者坐小船，来和齐人谈判，希望解开不知道怎么造成的误会，以及，有了付出大量赎金赎回娇妻的心理准备。
和他们谈判的是曹玮，来见亲王殿下，自是禀告和诺曼底公爵使者的会面情况。
曹玮的回复很是简单粗暴，首先，齐人希望和诺曼底公爵和平相处；第二，索菲亚公主曾经向自己主母大量借贷，现今不远归还侮辱殴打自己主母，是以才引发了这场冲突；第三，因为诺曼底公爵不理智的行为使得双方船舰爆发了冲突，混乱中，索菲亚公主被诺曼人的流矢射中落水，已经打捞不到。
听曹玮的回报陆宁哭笑不得，尤其第三点，进可攻退可守，日后被人发现索菲亚的踪迹，或是自己需要和索菲亚在法兰西一起游玩，那么就可以说，一两天后，还是发现了落水的索菲亚，救助她上来后，她已经不愿意回卡昂。
曹玮，当然认为庞凤命令他行事，实际是自己看上了索菲亚，她出面做白脸而已。
考虑着，陆宁便要曹玮也派人与诺曼底公爵沟通，言道不管怎么说，索菲亚公主的死是一场悲剧，齐人表示遗憾之余，愿意支付五千银元的人道赔偿。
当然，本地大齐货币并不通行，价值也没得到体现，这五千银元，是用大齐最名贵的一种香水充抵。
除此之外，陆宁带的宝石也不少。
陆宁倒是巴不得将将大齐各皇庄盛产的各种宝石都送来欧洲，不过，宝石虽然不如金银硬通，送与这诺曼底公爵的话，毕竟他还可以和其他君主交换物资，也等于增加他的实力。
香水就不同了，虽然贵族闻其香以及试用其喷洒后的时效就会知道其在现今是顶级奢侈品，但毕竟香水不能长久保存，开封后不能急切转手的话，价值会大大降低。
陆宁怎么说曹玮当然就怎么办，虽然心里觉得亲王殿下太过仁义，抢个蛮族女子又有什么大不了，何必赔钱？若是自己是主帅，就趁机征服这卡昂城，不想长期占有就付之一炬掠了人口卖去不莱梅等自由城市市场，这些蛮子，通常征服异族城邦也都会这么干。
陆宁在船长舱房，和曹玮聊天，也等着消息往来。
到了夜晚，派出的使者终于回转，说到最后，是理查公爵亲自和他密谈。
当使者一口咬定索菲亚公主坠水后，理查公爵离开了两个多时辰，回到客室时，整个人都显得很悲怆，但最终同意齐人赔款五千银元的解决此事的方案，但他要求在双方对外公开的条约上，写明齐人赔款两万银元并以昂贵齐货相抵。
“不可！”陆宁听曹玮的话，立时拒绝。
曹玮一呆，其实反正是用齐国商人身份和他议定这赔款款项，签名也是用虚构齐商名字，理查想要面子，那就给他就是。
“如此，在他手里，那香水就可能有两万银元的价值。”陆宁摆摆手。
曹玮呆了呆，随之渐渐明白，继而恍然大悟，不由咬咬牙，“这家伙，我看早晚是个隐患，殿下，不如小的派人……”恶狠狠做了个手势。
陆宁摆摆手，“那也不用。”
几日后，诺曼底理查公爵沉痛的向宫廷重臣们宣布，因为和齐国商人的误会，其敬爱的妻子索菲亚，自告奋勇前去齐国商船谈判时，误坠水身亡。
content_en:
Outside the ship building, Lu Ning listened to Isabel's timid narration. This Isabel was really Sofia's cousin. Now she had been bathed by Concubine Pang. Her tattered clothes were replaced by the snow-white sailor student uniforms of several English slave girls. She became more and more bright and charming. She and Sofia really became a pair of extremely beautiful Parisian aristocratic sisters, but Sofia was more beautiful, while Isabel was more pure and sweet.
Sofia sat aside with a proud look on her face. Even half an hour ago, she had just seen from the porthole the ship full of people using terrifying fireballs and rocket rain to turn the Duke of Normandy's flagship into a sea of ​​flames. The Duke of Normandy hurriedly boarded a small boat to escape under the escort of his guards.
When she heard Isabel talk about the past, she would glare at Isabel viciously when she met someone who didn't match her memory.
Isabel was very afraid of her and did not dare to look in her direction.
According to Isabel, Sophia's cousin's family is very good to her, but because the Duke of Normandy is still considered a Viking by the French nobles, there is inevitably a lot of gossip about Sophia who is going to marry a Viking. In addition, Sophia was originally Louis V The only child of the King of the World, Louis V loved her very much. She was always at the top of the court and in the aristocratic circle of Paris. The little child suddenly suffered the tragedy of the death of her father and was usurped from the throne. For a while, her maids fled one after another, thinking that she would be implicated if her status as a princess was not preserved.
How can a child of four or five years old bear such a huge change? She may have a very sensitive psychological problem. Therefore, the experience at her cousin's house may have been an extremely bad experience for her. So, for some reason, not long after she got married, her cousin's house suddenly became the person she hated the most.
Today, the relationship between Richard II, Duke of Normandy, and Robert II, King of France, is extremely close.
The Kingdom of France is a kingdom with a relatively complete feudal system. Especially the Capetian family has just been in power for more than ten years. The dukes of the principalities do not listen to the orders from Paris at all. Even the Duke of Burgundy in the south simply does not regard the King of France as a human being and often goes north to invade and plunder.
King Robert II of France could only contain these powerful princes who were ready to move by relying on the Normans.
The decline of Isabel's family was rumored to be due to the dissatisfaction of the Duke of Normandy.
Not long ago, Isabel received a letter from Sophia, saying that she was going to marry a chief in England.
If the Norman Duke is still regarded as a barbarian by many French nobles, the English chief is a primitive man in their eyes.
Of course Isabel was unwilling, and the result was that a few days ago, she was kidnapped on her way to the monastery to meet her friends. From the kidnappers, she learned that her cousin was the mastermind behind it.
Listening to Isabel's story, Lu Ning looked at Sophia amusedly, "You have a bit of a vicious heart."
Sophia's pretty face was cold and she ignored Lu Ning.
The voice of an English slave girl outside: "Master, Mr. Cao wants to see grandpa."
Naturally, Concubine Pang taught them how to address their master.
…
Not only was the hastily assembled naval force beaten to pieces by the Hedong and its frigates, but the Qi people also took the opportunity to burn many of their ships parked at the dock. Although the Hedong did not represent the latest naval technology of Daqi, an offshore battle might It is more powerful than the Donghai-class ocean-going ships. For example, the fire-throwing bombs that combine heavy fire oil and gunpowder are specially prepared for close combat. They are probably more destructive than Greek fire. They are the best weapons for burning local ships parked at the dock.
Richard II, the Duke of Normandy, obviously found sadly that for some reason, nine out of ten of the ships he owned had been lost. Now the Qi people could just leave in a big way, but he, not only could only watch, but he would even have no chance to find the Qi people who kidnapped his wife.
Therefore, Richard II sent an envoy in a small boat to negotiate with the Qi people, hoping to resolve the misunderstanding caused by unknown reasons, and to be mentally prepared to pay a large ransom to redeem his beloved wife.
The person negotiating with them was Cao Wei. He came to see His Highness the Prince and reported the meeting with the envoy of the Duke of Normandy.
Cao Wei's reply was very simple and rude. First of all, the people of Qi hoped to live in peace with the Duke of Normandy; secondly, Princess Sophia had borrowed a large amount from her mistress, and now she returned it and insulted and beat her mistress, which triggered this conflict; thirdly, because of the irrational behavior of the Duke of Normandy, a conflict broke out between the ships of the two sides. In the chaos, Princess Sophia was shot by a Norman arrow and fell into the water, and could not be salvaged.
Listening to Cao Wei's report, Lu Ning couldn't laugh or cry, especially the third point. You can advance, attack, retreat or defend. If someone discovers Sophia's traces in the future, or she needs to play with Sophia in France, then it can be said that a day or two later, she still found Sophia falling into the water. After rescuing her, she was no longer willing to return to Caen.
Cao Wei, of course, thought that Pang Feng ordered him to act, but in fact, he fell in love with Sophia, and she was just showing off.
After thinking about it, Lu Ning asked Cao Wei to send someone to communicate with the Duke of Normandy, saying that no matter what, the death of Princess Sophia was a tragedy. The Qi people expressed regret and were willing to pay a humane compensation of five thousand silver dollars.
Of course, the local Daqi currency was not widely used, and its value was not reflected. The five thousand silver dollars were paid for with one of the most expensive perfumes in Daqi.
In addition, Lu Ning also brought many gems.
Lu Ning was eager to send all kinds of gems abundantly produced in the imperial palaces of Da Qi to Europe. However, although gems were not as good as gold and silver, if they were sent to the Duke of Normandy, after all, he could exchange supplies with other monarchs, which would also increase his strength.
Perfume is different. Although aristocrats will know that it is a top luxury product when they smell its fragrance and test the time after spraying, after all, perfume cannot be stored for a long time. If it is not eager to change hands after opening, the value will be greatly reduced.
Of course Lu Ning would do whatever Cao Wei said. Although he felt that His Royal Highness was too benevolent and righteous, what was the big deal if he snatched a barbarian woman? Why should he pay for it? If he were the coach, he would take the opportunity to conquer the city of Caen. If he didn't want to occupy it for a long time, he would burn it, plunder the people, and sell them to the markets of free cities such as Bremen. These barbarians usually do this when they conquer foreign city-states.
Lu Ning was in the captain's cabin, chatting with Cao Wei, and waiting for news.
At night, the envoys sent finally returned. In the end, it was Duke Richard himself who had a secret conversation with him.
When the envoy insisted that Princess Sophia fell into the water, Duke Richard left for more than two hours. When he returned to the guest room, he looked very sad, but finally agreed to the solution of the matter in which the Qi people paid a compensation of 5,000 silver dollars. However, he requested that it be written in the public treaty between the two parties that the Qi people should pay a compensation of 20,000 silver dollars and pay for it with expensive goods.
"No!" Lu Ning heard Cao Wei's words and immediately refused.
Cao Wei was stunned. In fact, he negotiated the compensation amount with him as a Qi merchant, and the signature was a fictitious Qi merchant name. If Richard wanted to save face, then give it to him.
"In this case, in his hands, the perfume may be worth 20,000 silver dollars." Lu Ning waved his hand.
Cao Wei was stunned, then gradually understood, and then suddenly realized, he couldn't help gritting his teeth, "I think this guy will be a hidden danger sooner or later. Your Highness, why don't you send someone..." He made a fierce gesture.
Lu Ning waved his hand, "That's not necessary."
…
A few days later, Duke Richard of Normandy sadly announced to the court officials that due to a misunderstanding with Qi merchants, his beloved wife Sophia accidentally fell into the water and died when she volunteered to negotiate with Qi merchant ships.
